mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently reduces equity discount rates by lowering risk-free rates, increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 0.5% within one month signals imminent monetary tightening, raising equity discount rates and reducing valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 despite negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through non-additive interaction.
failure_condition: Joint movement of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term p-value >0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer spending (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) indicates robust household demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days in high-spending regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 400000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 for the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) signals weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts trend (HOUST month-over-month increase) indicates improving consumer confidence and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through consistent momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a self-reinforcing economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through synergistic interaction.
failure_condition: Joint growth of HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances, or interaction term p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) triggers Federal Reserve policy tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days in high-inflation regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 for the signal.
